scripts.build: bun run --filter '@bao/server' build && bun run --filter '@bao/client' build
scripts.start:railway: (PORT=3000 bun run packages/server/dist/index.js &) && sleep 2 && bun packages/client/.output/server/index.mjs
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter '@bao/shared' typecheck && bun run --filter '@bao/scraper' typecheck && bun run --filter '@bao/server' typecheck && bun run --filter '@bao/client' typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --filter '@bao/shared' test && bun run --filter '@bao/server' test && bun run --filter '@bao/scraper' test && bun run --filter '@bao/client' test
scripts.audit:integration: bun run audit:official-llms && bun run verify:pages
scripts.audit:stack-versions: for pkg in bun nuxt tailwindcss daisyui elysia @elysiajs/eden drizzle-orm drizzle-kit @tauri-apps/cli @tauri-apps/api; do printf "%s\t" "$pkg"; bunx npm view "$pkg" version; done
scripts.validate:stack-alignment: bun run verify:bun-baseline && bun run audit:stack-versions
scripts.validate:alignment: bun run validate:stack-alignment && bun run validate:ui-layout-tokens && bun run validate:daisyui-contracts
scripts.audit:full: bun ci && bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run build && bun run ci:alignment && bun run audit:integration && bun run release:verify
scripts.lint: bun run validate:alignment && bun run validate:no-try-catch && bun run validate:no-unsafe-casts && bun run validate:no-hardcoded-paths && bun run validate:locales && bun run validate:page-seo && bun run validate:i18n-ui && bun run validate:aria && bun run validate:ui && bun run validate:ascii && bun run lint:typed && bun --bun run biome lint . --max-diagnostics=1200 && bun run --filter '@bao/client' lint && bun run typecheck
scripts.lint:fix: bun run validate:alignment && bun run validate:no-try-catch && bun run validate:no-unsafe-casts && bun run validate:no-hardcoded-paths && bun run validate:locales && bun run validate:page-seo && bun run validate:i18n-ui && bun run validate:aria && bun run validate:ui && bun run validate:ascii && bun run lint:typed:fix && bun --bun run biome lint . --write --max-diagnostics=1200 && bun run --filter '@bao/client' lint --fix && bun run typecheck
